intel: ipu3: Release last RAW buffer early Currently to make sure the two pipes outputs are the same, the last request raw buffer is not released until the current request processes completely. If the request processing time is too long, the raw buffers may be consumed quickly so that the other requests will be droped. This patch releases the last raw buffer immediately when it is not used any more. BUG=b:117583021 TEST=Make sure camera works on soraka. Change-Id: Icad6b5ec20270d0f2d91c4d0f935293471ed0d05 Signed-off-by: Hongju Wang <hongju.wang@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1351082 Commit-Ready: Wei Meng <wei.meng@intel.corp-partner.google.com> Tested-by: Wei Meng <wei.meng@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Wei Meng <wei.meng@intel.com>

mosys: oak: get version from cros_ec Since chromium:663243, the board version reported by mosys should be "revN" for both x86 and non-x86 platforms. Few older platforms, for example nyan and oak, were printing whole device tree identifier which is not the right format, and cannot really identify board revision. As a result we should fix that by using the version reported from EC.
